children: UBS initiating coverage on AI infrastructure firm CoreWeave (CRWV, Financials) is drawing renewed Wall Street attention amid the company's $4.2 billion debt issuance.
UBS analyst Karl Keirstead started coverage with a Buy rating and a $120 price target. Solid demand for AI processing and higher revenue per gigawatt are fueling CoreWeave's expansion, he says.

The bullish situation involves a financing trade-off. The new convertible senior notes of CoreWeave will maturity in 2033 with an annual interest rate of 2.875%. The transaction produced net proceeds of around $4.14 billion.
The notes carry an initial conversion price of $97.85 per share, a 22.5% premium to CoreWeave's Sept. 17 closing price. Existing stockholders could be diluted if the notes convert.

CoreWeave also paid $566 million for capped call transactions to mitigate the risk of dilution under certain share-price scenarios. The remainder of the proceeds may be used for general business purposes.
CoreWeave gets more funds to create its AI infrastructure, but the company has to turn its big investment and growing AI demand into long-term revenue.
The next catalyst is CoreWeave's ability to turn its growing footprint of infrastructure into increased revenue and cash generation while minimizing its debt burden.

title: CoreWeave Just Got a Big Vote of Confidence But There's a Catch
